notes: Predeclared demonstration heuristics, not empirically validated commercial thresholds. Exact sector AI postings are the denominator of the sector course/posting ratio; courses count toward a sector only when their title names it, using a declared pattern for each of 28 categories; unmapped categories receive no supply count. The v3.1 patterns were revised after a blind stratified review and scored on held-out courses (AI-reviewer labels, not yet human-reviewed): precision about 0.90, recall about 0.57, so the count is a lower bound on sector supply (outputs/provider_demo/sector_mapping_validation). Audience fit is title-token screening, not proof of occupational suitability. A gap is a text-mention difference, not learner deficit. Differentiation is a documented design hypothesis grounded in outcome passages, never proven novelty. All thresholds and weights are stress-tested; uncertainty remains. The supply limit is a new-launch gate. An explicit adaptation brief may proceed in a crowded sector only with an identified baseline course and usable outcome evidence; this is not a finding of limited supply.
